title: Resolve event expiry and crawl eligibility against the host timezone
detail: Source-confirmed mismatch requiring scoped follow-up: lib/events/datetime.ts stores host wall-clock parts as UTC-naive values, but eventHasEnded compares those values directly with now. lib/discover.ts uses it for public-event expiry and lib/events/series-seo.ts for sitemap eligibility, without passing time_zone. For an America/Los_Angeles event ending 2026-06-26T19:00:00Z in storage, at 2026-06-27T00:00:00Z the helper reports ended although host time is only 17:00. The canonical lib/time/zone.ts eventInstant seam interprets the wall-clock correctly. Trace public RPC/listing filters and zone enrichment before repairing so page, metadata and sitemap agree without adding expensive imports across public build roots. Prior LIVE-199 fixed JSON-LD zone enrichment, not this expiry seam. No production event rows were inspected and no live impact was asserted. Repair: reuse canonical isEventPast through eventHasEnded; thread the existing safe enrichment timezone into the public page and project time_zone on the existing metadata and sitemap reads. No additional queries or new timezone dependency in either consuming module (both already import lib/time/zone). The actual sitemap consequence probe now uses stored wall-clock Z fixtures rather than misleading explicit-offset instants, validates metadata query zone propagation and Pacific/London expiry, and failed before the repair. Real public page rendering and metadata tests cover Pacific before/after cutoff, London summer offset, absent-zone fallback and cancellation; helper tests add Pacific/London winter offsets and exact boundary behavior. RPC listing filter and missing listing-zone projection remain separately open under SCAN-1037. Local mocked reads/rendering only, no production proof. Final validation: 1,422 tests across 92 event/time/discover/public-page suites passed, changed-file lint passed, all 26 source guards passed with migration guard explicitly partial without a fresh ledger input. Static backlog validation passed and does not constitute cmd-probe execution. Probe-cost correction on 2026-10-23: the prior ledger command reran the full test runner (node node_modules/vitest/vitest.mjs run --cache=false --fsModuleCachePath .next/cache/audit-vitest --maxWorkers=2 lib/events/end-time.test.ts lib/events/sitemap-eligibility.test.ts app/\(public\)/events/\[slug\]/public-expiry.render.test.tsx). Keep those comprehensive behavior tests in normal CI; the ledger now executes the actual code/fixture consequence directly without a nested runner. No assertion or application gate is waived.

verify.note: Actual public metadata and Frequency SSR body agree on host-local expiry; actual sitemap reader retains Pacific evening rows, respects London expiry, selects host timezone and preserves series ordinal allowances. Mocked database, no production reads or writes. Normal CI retains the fuller test suites; this direct probe keeps the per-row guard bounded.
